# Aura ID — Universal Agent Registry & KYA (Know Your Agent) Protocol

> Global Agent Identity Standard, Post-CAPTCHA Machine Passports (`agent.json`), and Scoped Human Taste Tokens (`aura-id/taste-token`) for the Agentic Web.

- Canonical Web App: https://souleria.github.io/aura-id/
- Source Repository: https://github.com/souleria/aura-id
- Machine Discovery Manifest: https://souleria.github.io/aura-id/.well-known/agent.json
- LLM Discovery Index: https://souleria.github.io/aura-id/llms.txt

## 1. Protocol Overview (Why Aura ID Exists)

Legacy websites block autonomous AI agents with visual CAPTCHA puzzles because they cannot distinguish an unauthorized scraper from a legitimate agent acting on behalf of a human. Aura ID establishes two open, cryptographic standards:

1. **Know Your Agent (KYA) & Machine Passport (`aura-id/agent.json` v1.0)**:
   Every AI agent is provisioned with a deterministic **Verified Agent ID** (e.g. `AURA-BUY-8D1F-43A0`), an **Ed25519 public verification key**, a verified **Owner Domain** (`souleria.github.io`), declared **Capabilities** (`catalog_search`, `cart_staging`, `code_review`), and explicit **Spend/Action Boundaries** (`$150 / session`). Gateways verify these cryptographic headers to grant instant, CAPTCHA-free access.
2. **Scoped Human Taste Token (`aura-id/taste-token` v0.2)**:
   A zero-PII preference and intent token (`privacy: "scoped-handshake-no-pii"`) that carries a user's aesthetic taste, material constraints, sizes, and active shopping list so personal agents can negotiate directly with merchant agents without exposing personal identity.

## 2. Standard Agent Discovery & Verification Endpoints

- `GET /.well-known/agent.json` — Machine-readable KYA Registry manifest, public verification keys, and registered seed agents.
- `GET /llms.txt` — Structured documentation for autonomous agents and LLM crawlers.
- `GET /api/taste-token` — Local MCP/HTTP endpoint returning the current user's scoped Taste Token.
- `POST /api/a2a/store-match` — Agent-to-Agent (A2A) catalog matching endpoint.

## 3. HTTP Handshake Headers (Post-CAPTCHA Gateway)

When an Aura-equipped agent sends an HTTP request to a participating platform or merchant gateway, it includes:

```http
X-Aura-Agent-ID: AURA-BUY-8D1F-43A0
X-Aura-Owner-Domain: souleria.github.io
X-Aura-Public-Key: ed25519:pk_aura_8d1f43a099b2c4e1d7a3f5012b8c
X-Aura-Trust-Score: 98/100
X-Aura-Taste-Token: scoped-handshake-no-pii
```
